definition: Philip Hilaire Sean Torr (born 1966) is a British scientist and a professor at the University of Oxford.
details: His research interests are in machine learning and computer vision and he is a fellow of St Catherine's College, Oxford.
story: Picture walking through a crowd and instantly picking out a familiar face without reading a single name tag. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. It turns a picture into an understanding: this is a cat, that is a stop sign. Sight, for a machine, is a long climb from raw light to a name. And that is Philip Torr — giving a machine the gift of sight.
